title: Greek Stew with Kick
description: A hearty Greek-inspired stew with a spicy kick, perfect for a chilly evening. This dish combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with a bold twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, beef broth, and hot sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or oregano.
